{
  "findings": [
    {
      "ref": "[R3]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app allows multiple profiles for kids.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This game is so fun and entertaining I recommend getting it for your kids and also you can make a bunch of profiles with your kids"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R4]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app targets children up to age 7 and suggests it is suitable for ages 5+.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Cute game! Especially for a 7yr old^^ ... I Recommend this game for toddlers/kids over the age of 7/5+ :)"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R23]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app's 8+ rating and limited content up to 2nd grade feels too childish for a 7-year-old.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "It says 8+ and it only goes up to 2nd grade and this is a bit childish for a 7 year old because it was giving like easy things"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R43]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app previously included 3rd grade but removed it, leaving only up to 2nd grade.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "So last time I was playing this game when I was little there was pre to third grade and after updates grade 3 is like gone where did it go like pls bring it back even tho I’m in 5th grade"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R55]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app only goes up to 2nd grade and a 10-year-old finds it insufficient, threatening to delete it.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "I am  10 years old and the app literally lets you choose your grade from pre-k to 2nd grade. Where is 5th grade?! You need to change this “age thing” immediately or I will delete the app."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R57]",
      "area": "age_gating",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app's age range is too small, as an 11-year-old enjoys it but is limited to 2nd grade content.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "So the game is really fun but the age range is to small I like it and I’m 11 so the highest it goes is 2nd grade even though older kids like it too. Just try to put the age range a little higher like maybe up to middle school, thats all I’m asking."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R32]",
      "area": "contact",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app lacks sufficient parental controls to remove or disable content.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "Parents should be able to remove or disable certain videos and other contents for kits to see."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R26]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app includes yoga routines that conflict with their Catholic beliefs.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Yoga carries specific spiritual intentions that conflict entirely with our Catholic beliefs, and I do not want this introduced to my daughter."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R18]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports disturbing Halloween-themed content appeared unexpectedly, violating child-friendly expectations.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "A grid of scary devil faces and men tied up with their mouth taped shut popped up for about 15 seconds while my kid was working on math. Very disturbing and disappointing since this is such a widely advertised app for homeschooling"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R44]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app uses subscriptions as a common monetization tactic, with pricing at $50.99 in the USA and $30.50 in the UK, described as 'too pricey'.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "In the USA it cost 50.99$ for the subscription and in the UK it cost 30.50$ they might reduce the price to be honest because it is to pricey for that amount ;-;"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R45]",
      "area": "money",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app is free, eliminating cost concerns for families.",
      "stance": "mitigation",
      "quote": "ACTUALLY FREE YOU DONT NEED TO PAY Thank goodness I use khan academy for school work so when I found out they had a learning games for kids I was so happy and I thought “ they teach fee videos on YouTube “ and it absolutely was free glad to know someone cares for our youth"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R13]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app collects no data for ads or third parties, as it is free and ad-free.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Love everything about this app . My kid learns a lot here. Kudos to khan academy for creating this resource free for everyone"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R47]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app does not track or share data, as it is free and designed for educational use.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I love the app is very good and free. I have paid for other apps, but really like this one. As a student I used KhAacdemy so I tried this for my kid."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R79]",
      "area": "data",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app has no ads and is completely free, with no data collection concerns.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "This is a very great game, and I recommend it 💯 percent! Coasts no money! Free from adds! GET THIS GAME NOW! You will be sorry if you don’t get this game right now!!! Khan academy kids download now for free on App Store! 📱5 STARS!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R1]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app is created by Khan Academy, a well-known educational nonprofit with no mentioned regulatory issues.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Excellent educational resource! My son has been using this app from he is 2 years and I must say it has taught him basically everything he knows. Thank you!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R7]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app is used by teachers and homeschooling families as a trusted educational resource.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "I LOVE this app! I signed up as a teacher and assign activities for my kiddo to do before she can play around with the other features. As a homeschool mom, this is such an amazing resource that I can use to support our lessons."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R51]",
      "area": "developer_record",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app is free, ad-free, and praised as an excellent educational tool for kids.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Fantastic Khan academy made this excellent and beautiful app for my kid for FREE! Can’t ask for more, thank you!"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R24]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app offers fun, educational activities that a 3-year-old loves and finds valuable for learning letters and counting.",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "quote": "Fun children’s lessons, my 3 year old loves it! Such a wonderful resource, I rarely write reviews but I think this app and company deserves it. It’s the first thing my daughter asks to play after school every day. Really helps with counting and letters at her age."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R28]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app's content became too advanced for their 5th grader, who was limited to 2nd grade material.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "My kid is a fifth grader and it only went to second grade will be pressed 8+ and it didn’t even go up the grade It only stayed at second grade and down."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R42]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app is good for 5-year-olds but too limited for 3rd grade, requiring more advanced material.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Good but limited Good for 5 YEAR OLDS it only goes up to second grade and I am going to third grade so I need something more advanced but it is still a very good kid learning app"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R38]",
      "area": "content",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app lacks sufficient content for 4th grade and above, causing disappointment.",
      "stance": "risk",
      "quote": "Iwas looking for 4th grade and more for my kid this is outrages i thought this would work"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R52]",
      "area": "bugs",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app crashed during use, showing disturbing content (green bear story) before crashing.",
      "stance": "bugs",
      "quote": "So it keeps crashing and I think the crashing and my son was playing and when he was playing a a story played with a green bear and he was looking at the screen then red showed up and then it crashed pls fix! Also the pink bow isn’t that serious guys"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R46]",
      "area": "bugs",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app is non-functional, freezing on the setup page after reinstallation.",
      "stance": "bugs",
      "quote": "App does not work The app is inoperable. It has been reinstalled and freezes on the set up page."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R48]",
      "area": "bugs",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app repeatedly fails to load, preventing profile creation or access to parent controls.",
      "stance": "bugs",
      "quote": "Busted app Your app does nothing but perpetually load whether trying to get into a fresh profile to start, to click parent options, or even attempt to create a new profile from scratch in case there was an issue with the other profile. Over it."
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R50]",
      "area": "bugs",
      "claim": "A parent calls the app 'garbage' due to poor performance.",
      "stance": "bugs",
      "quote": "Dont get Garbage"
    },
    {
      "ref": "[R73]",
      "area": "bugs",
      "claim": "A parent reports the app is 'very, very bad' and advises others not to buy it.",
      "stance": "bugs",
      "quote": "Very, very bad Terrible I hate this app!! do not buy this. It is so bad."
    }
  ]
